paragraphs: Tyler Technologies sells software and services designed for government and schools. One product line the pages set out in detail is appraisal and tax, which covers property assessment and computer-assisted mass appraisal software. The same line covers tax billing and collection software for processing bills, payments, and property information.

Alongside software, the pages offer mass appraisal services ranging from data collection to appeal support. The property and recording business launched in 1938. The pages state work in 49 states, 26 state capitals, and four Canadian provinces.
Buyers are described as ranging from small rural counties to large metropolitan cities. The homepage names the public sector as the market served.

quote.text: From small rural counties to large metropolitan cities, we've got you covered.
